description: The National Media and Infocommunications Authority, Hungary's media and telecoms regulator, publishes half-yearly market reports on the supply side of the communications markets, built from figures reported by the main operators. The mobile market report and the fixed (helyhez kötött) market report each appear twice a year, from the second half of 2018 to the second half of 2025, as a PDF with an Excel workbook of data tables. The mobile report for the second half of 2025 notes that between early 2022 and late 2025 subscriptions grew only for M2M cards (about 17 percent a year), voice-capable subscriptions were flat, and non-M2M mobile data traffic grew 22 percent a year and made up 17 percent of total data traffic including fixed internet. It also notes that a residential postpaid subscriber makes about 300 minutes of calls a month, a prepaid one about a tenth of that. The regulator also runs the szelessav.net speed test with fixed probes and has begun mobile coverage measurement along cycle paths. Coverage: Hungary, national and by operator where given. Format and access: PDF reports and XLSX tables, free. Caveats: reports are in Hungarian; tables are national; methods and definitions change between editions. Simulation uses: mobile and fixed traffic growth and M2M uptake for capacity planning. Related records: the Digital Decade DESI indicators give Hungary's coverage figures; the BTK electronic communications market data and the Nordic-Baltic telecom market statistics are comparable regulator series.
